panels.title: Visits
panels.description: Browser sessions that loaded any page, this week, against the week before. Counted by the page itself (frontend/count.js), so crawlers and blocked scripts are left out.

panels.title: New visitors
panels.description: Visits from a browser never seen before. Counted by the page itself (frontend/count.js), so crawlers and blocked scripts are left out.

panels.title: Searches
panels.description: Searches someone typed or picked on the board.

panels.title: Job views
panels.description: Listings opened on the board, or their own page loaded.

panels.title: Apply clicks
panels.description: Clicks out to the employer's posting. The value the site delivers.

panels.title: Sign-ins
panels.description: Completed sign-ins, any method.

panels.title: Visits over time
panels.description: Visits per hour, and how many came from a browser seen for the first time.

panels.title: Job views and apply clicks
panels.description: Listings opened, and clicks out to the employer, per hour.

panels.title: Searches
panels.description: Board searches per hour.

panels.title: Apply clicks per 100 visits
panels.description: Of every hundred visits in a day, how many ended in a click out to an employer.

targets.expression: IF(SUM(SEARCH('{OceanOfJobs,event} MetricName="Events" event="visit"', 'Sum', 86400)) > 0, 100 * FILL(SUM(SEARCH('{OceanOfJobs,event} MetricName="Events" event="apply"', 'Sum', 86400)), 0) / SUM(SEARCH('{OceanOfJobs,event} MetricName="Events" event="visit"', 'Sum', 86400)), 0)
targets.label: Apply clicks per 100 visits

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Every account in the user pool, read hourly.

panels.title: New accounts this week
panels.description: Accounts created in the last seven days.

panels.title: Active alerts
panels.description: Alerts switched on.

panels.title: People with alerts
panels.description: Accounts with at least one alert on.

panels.title: Alerts created
panels.description: New alerts saved this week.

panels.title: Digests sent
panels.description: Alert emails sent this week. SES is still in its sandbox, so only verified addresses get them.

panels.title: Traffic at the edge, crawlers included
Total requests
panels.description: Every request CloudFront answered this week.

panels.title: Data transfer
panels.description: Bytes sent to viewers this week.

panels.title: 4xx error rate
panels.description: Share of requests answered 4xx, averaged over the week.

panels.title: 5xx error rate
panels.description: Share of requests that failed on our side, averaged over the week.

panels.title: Requests over time
panels.description: Requests per hour, people and crawlers alike.

panels.title: Data transfer
panels.description: Bytes sent per hour.

panels.title: Requests by status code
panels.description: Requests per six hours, split by CloudFront's 4xx and 5xx rates.

targets.expression: SUM(SEARCH('{AWS/CloudFront,DistributionId,Region} MetricName="Requests" DistributionId="E3UCZ5WT5SLUVY" Region="Global"', 'Sum', 21600)) * (100 - FILL(SUM(SEARCH('{AWS/CloudFront,DistributionId,Region} MetricName="4xxErrorRate" DistributionId="E3UCZ5WT5SLUVY" Region="Global"', 'Average', 21600)), 0) - FILL(SUM(SEARCH('{AWS/CloudFront,DistributionId,Region} MetricName="5xxErrorRate" DistributionId="E3UCZ5WT5SLUVY" Region="Global"', 'Average', 21600)), 0)) / 100
targets.label: 2xx and 3xx

targets.expression: SUM(SEARCH('{AWS/CloudFront,DistributionId,Region} MetricName="Requests" DistributionId="E3UCZ5WT5SLUVY" Region="Global"', 'Sum', 21600)) * FILL(SUM(SEARCH('{AWS/CloudFront,DistributionId,Region} MetricName="4xxErrorRate" DistributionId="E3UCZ5WT5SLUVY" Region="Global"', 'Average', 21600)), 0) / 100
targets.label: 4xx

targets.expression: SUM(SEARCH('{AWS/CloudFront,DistributionId,Region} MetricName="Requests" DistributionId="E3UCZ5WT5SLUVY" Region="Global"', 'Sum', 21600)) * FILL(SUM(SEARCH('{AWS/CloudFront,DistributionId,Region} MetricName="5xxErrorRate" DistributionId="E3UCZ5WT5SLUVY" Region="Global"', 'Average', 21600)), 0) / 100
targets.label: 5xx
